name: Dot
description: A survivor drawn alone, at eight heads, in leather and wool — the plain one, the one whose weapon is its own feelers, dressed like someone who walks a long way. The head is `ss.lib.dot-head` composed at a fifth of its size: a leather coif under a deep wool hood bound in leather, the face a shadow behind a cloth wrap with two cold glints in it, a scarf at the throat. Below it a wool mantle over the shoulders, bound in leather and stitched; a laced leather jerkin over a wool tunic, with the dead pheromone organ worn on a cord as a pendant where the hive's would be lit; a leather belt with a bone buckle and a pouch; wool sleeves into stitched leather bracers and gloves; wool trousers into leather boots strapped and buckled to the knee; the lash — a mandible on a cord — coiled at the near hip. Behind it all a long wool cloak falls from the shoulders to the calves, bound in leather at the hem. What makes Dot Dot is the feelers: two dead antennae rooted in leather grommets at the crown of the hood, grown far past any other survivor's, that rise, bend forward and hang limp down over the face and chest to the belt, swaying when the body moves and sweeping, slowly, when it does not. No skin shows anywhere; the hive reads scent, and a body wrapped this tight gives it nothing. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: standing under the hood, still: a slow breath through the jerkin that the mantle rides, the pendant swinging a hair on its cord, the cloak's hem barely stirring, the near hand hanging loose in its glove — and the two long dead feelers, hung limp over the face and chest, swaying on a beat of their own, the only thing on the field that keeps searching

walk.description: a long stride under a long cloak: the knees bend and the boots come through the hem, the cloak is thrown back on every step, the near arm swings out of it with the elbow bent, the pendant swings on its cord, and the two limp feelers swing forward and back over the chest a beat behind the shoulders
